_comment: AgentCore's auto-created execution role (AmazonBedrockAgentCoreSDKRuntime-{region}-{hash}) only gets Bedrock + logs + X-Ray + ECR by default -- your app's own permissions are never included (see the hackathon deployment reference, section 4B). This is what the DEPLOYED AGENT itself needs to use DynamoDBCaseStore, attached to that execution role, not to the deploying-user identity in agentcore-iam-bootstrap-policy.json. Replace YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID, YOUR_REGION, and YOUR_TABLE_NAME below with your actual values (YOUR_TABLE_NAME must match SMISH_CASE_TABLE).
